p.title: v59.97 refresh integrity gate refused every key-present partial FRED cycle that the producer had labelled as last-known-good
p.symptom: With FRED_API_KEY present, one series failing both attempts makes fredFetchOk false while the producer labels the cycle fredLkgUsed true / fredLkgSource 'previous-public-data-macro'. ci-refresh-artifact-integrity-check refused that cycle (degradedFred=true) because its explicit LKG boundary required the key to be absent, so quotes, news and history were not published either, and every later cycle was refused the same way until all series succeeded in one run.
p.root_cause: The LKG boundary was written for the key-absent local cycle only. fredFetchOk is the all-series-complete flag (deriveFredCycle complete), so with the key present a single failed series is indistinguishable from a total loss unless the gate reads the producer's own labels. The gate began comparing against the last published data.json in v59.94, which made the trap reachable.
p.fix: The boundary now holds when fredFetchOk is not true, fredLkgUsed is true and fredLkgSource is a non-empty string, with or without the key; with the key present at least one series must have succeeded (fredSuccessfulSeries non-empty), so a key-present total loss is still refused. An unlabelled regression or a label without a source is refused as before. The printed JSON now carries fred.failed and fred.expected so the operator log shows a partial cycle.
p.violated_rule: P1189 (a partial-failure FRED cycle is meant to publish under an explicit LKG label); P1085 (one provider outage must not look like a total pipeline outage).
p.prevention: ci-data-pipeline-contract-check v59.97 temp-repository cases: key-present labelled partial passes and prints failed/expected; key-present labelled total loss refused; key-present unlabelled regression refused; LKG label with null source refused; the v59.94 key-absent LKG case still passes.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-data-pipeline-contract-check.mjs exit 0; the partial-labelled case failed on the gate before the change ('FRED success regressed'); node scripts/ci-refresh-artifact-integrity-check.mjs printed ok:true with fred.failed 0, fred.expected 23.

changelog: **A labelled partial FRED cycle publishes ({P}):** the refresh integrity gate accepts a key-present cycle in which some FRED series failed and the producer kept their last-known-good values with a named source, and still refuses a total loss or an unlabelled regression; its log now shows failed/expected series counts.
note: v59.97: FRED partial LKG cycle passes the integrity gate
